title: Ice, water, steam
hook: Water can be a hard cube, a drink, or a cloud of steam. Heat makes it change.

steps.caption: Ice is water that is frozen hard. Add heat and it starts to melt.

nodeCaptions.ice: Ice is cold and hard. You can hold a cube.
nodeCaptions.water: Melted ice becomes water you can drink.

steps.caption: Keep heating the water. Some of it turns into steam in the air.

nodeCaptions.water: Hot water can make tiny bits fly up as steam.
nodeCaptions.steam: Steam is water in the air. It looks like a soft cloud.

steps.caption: Cool the steam down and it can become water again. Same water — different shapes!

nodeCaptions.steam: When steam cools, it turns back into drops of water.
nodeCaptions.water: Ice, water, and steam are the same stuff in different forms.

takeaways: Ice, water, and steam are the same water in different forms.
Heat can melt ice and make steam. Cooling can bring water back.
Scientists call these solid, liquid, and gas — three shapes of stuff.

quiz.question: What do you add to ice to turn it into water?
Steam is…
quiz.explanation: Steam is water that has turned into a gas in the air.

quiz.question: Ice, water, and steam are…
choices: The same water in different forms
quiz.explanation: Same water — solid, liquid, or gas.
